scope: Confirmed original AccessKit copyright/derived-source headers for the six locked MIT-option packages. Retain beside complete MIT and BSD terms. Does not relabel whole crates.

records.extraction: Verbatim leading source copyright/license comment block, outer blank lines omitted and one final LF retained. Identical header in every listed resource. Full source bytes independently matched the exact pinned upstream archive. Additional per-source hashes are recorded below.
records.basis: Original source attributions and their explicit derived-code licensing notices; no holder inferred from author metadata.
